verdict.rationale: Firstbase's registered-agent/compliance dashboard gives an overview of state-by-state status and upcoming deadlines (firstbase-docs-7, firstbase-docs-14), which is the closest match to a compliance calendar, but there's no evidence of proactive reminder/notification mechanisms (email/SMS alerts) before deadlines. missing for 10: explicit reminder/notification feature description, evidence of calendar/alert scheduling, independent confirmation the dashboard surfaces deadlines accurately.
